Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.

Vinay Kumar, Advocate for the revisionist. 
 Heard. 
 Admit the revision. 
 Issue notice to the respondent. 
 Summon the lower court record. 
 In the meantime, there will be a stay subject to the 
condition that the revisionist pays a maintenance of 
Rs.17,000/- to the respondent, the effect and operation 
of the impugned order shall remain stayed. 
 Stay application stands disposed of.
